about: The asset library's packs runtime godot's own names resolve in, in order (builder/art/views.mjs findAsset): the 2D stand-ins of the game's style first (create puts flat-standins-<style> ahead of these), the pixel town's edges, dressing and set pieces, then the bodies and the shared clips a 3D game takes. Assets live in library/packs; this file holds no art.
